description: This file defines the TaxClass model class for the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations for tax classes and associated tax rules in the database.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing tax classes and rules within the OpenCart administration module.

methods.name: addTaxClass
methods.description: Creates a new tax class record in the database, potentially with associated tax rules.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Updates an existing tax class record and its associated tax rules.

methods.name: deleteTaxClass
methods.description: Deletes a tax class record and its related tax rules from the database.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax class record by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax class records, with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTaxClasses
methods.description: Returns the total number of tax class records.

methods.name: addTaxRule
methods.description: Adds a new tax rule linked to a specific tax class.

methods.name: deleteTaxRules
methods.description: Deletes all tax rules associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRules
methods.description: Fetches all tax rules associated with a given tax class.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRulesByTaxRateId
methods.description: Counts how many tax rules exist for a particular tax rate ID.
